SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
S. M. REGISTRY
3966
6 12 '32

COPY

Messrs Bureau of Public Safety.
City Government of Greater Shanghai
Nantao.

President
of the
Russian National Community
of Shanghai
17 August, 1932.
Shanghai China.

Dear Sirs,

I have much pleasure in recommending to your
kind attention the bearer of this Mr. S.L. Meilman,
a Russian emigrant duly registered at this
Community arrived from U.S.A. via Europe in July,
1932 who wishes at present to be registered at
your Bureau and to receive the passport enabling
him to proceed to the United States of America.

Mr. Meilman is known to this Community as a
quite reliable and law abiding person having no
connection with any subversive political party.
Therefore I should be much obliged if you would
kindly grant Mr. Meilman a necessary registration
and issue to him the passport.

Hoping that my request will be favourably
entertained by you.

I beg to remain,
Dear Sirs,
Yours faithfully,
P.P.R.C. Russia, President.
(Signed) N.V. Afanasieff.
Chairman of the Executive
Committee.

Reg.
aboard file 6
S.L. Meilman
JBR 6/9.

S. M. 登记处
3966
1932年12月6日

副本

致：上海市公安局
大上海市政府
南市。

上海俄罗斯侨民团
主席
1932年8月17日
中国上海。

尊敬的先生们：

本人非常荣幸地向贵局推荐本函持件人 S.L. Meilman 先生，他是一名已在该侨民团正式登记的俄罗斯侨民，于1932年7月经欧洲从美国抵达。他目前希望在贵局登记，并申领护照以便前往美利坚合众国。

本侨民团认为 Meilman 先生是一位相当可靠且守法的人士，与任何颠覆性政党均无关联。因此，如蒙贵局惠予批准 Meilman 先生进行必要登记并向其签发护照，本人将不胜感激。

恳请贵局对本请求予以 favorable consideration（有利考虑）。

此致
敬礼

俄罗斯侨民团主席
（签名）N.V. Afanasieff
执行委员会主席

登记
归档文件 6
S.L. Meilman
JBR 6/9.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. S. B. REGIST
D 3966
29 / 1 / 32
Special Branch S.2.
August 27, 1932.

Memorandum on Solomon Lvovich Meilman

Information has been received that one S.L. Meilman
who recently obtained an emigrants passport through the
assistance of "Soro" (Council of Russian Public Organizations
in Shanghai) formerly travelled on a Soviet Passport.
Meilman was registered with "Soro" as an emigrant on the
instructions of A. Kotenev, Chairman of "Soro" at the
request of J.G. Dobrishman, employee of Arnhold Co. In
his application Meilman stated that he is a Russian emigrant
of jewish faith and that he was born on October 11, 1908
in Shanghai and that he returned to this city in July, 1932,
from the United States via Europe. Nothing is mentioned in
his application regarding his previous papers of identity
and the document has not been endorsed by any guarantor
as is customary. Mr. Kotenev when approached explained
that Meilman had been registered on the strength of a
recommendation from Mr. J.G. Dobrishman. This, he contended,
was quite sufficient as Dobrishman is well known locally
and is a trusted employee of Mr. Arnhold through whom
material assistance has often been obtained by "Soro" and
also the "United Cossacks Association". What documents
Meilman held previously is unknown to Mr. Kotenev.

S.L. Meilman is the son of Mrs. R.S. Dobrishman by
her first husband. J.G. Dobrishman, his stepfather is
known to S.M.P. as a suspected Soviet Agent, is employed
with Arnhold and Co. as manager of "R" Department dealing
with Soviet products. He is reported to be connected with
Soviet Trade Mission and the local office of Centrosojus
(File I.O. 7860/16).

C. S. B. 登记
D 3966
1932年1月29日
特别处 S.2.
1932年8月27日。

关于 Solomon Lvovich Meilman 的备忘录

据获情报，一名 S.L. Meilman 近期在“索罗”（上海俄罗斯公共组织联合会）的协助下获得了侨民护照，此人此前曾持有苏联护照旅行。Meilman 系根据“索罗”主席 A. Kotenev 的指示，应 Arnhold 公司雇员 J.G. Dobrishman 的请求，以侨民身份在“索罗”登记。在其申请书中，Meilman 声称自己是一名犹太教信仰的俄罗斯侨民，于1908年10月11日出生于上海，并于1932年7月经欧洲从美国返回本市。其申请书中未提及此前的身份证明文件，且该文件未按惯例由任何担保人背书。Kotenev 先生在受询时解释称，Meilman 的登记是依据 J.G. Dobrishman 先生的推荐信办理的。他辩称这已完全足够，因为 Dobrishman 在当地广为人知，且是 Arnhold 先生信任的雇员，“索罗”以及“哥萨克联合协会”经常通过他获得物质援助。Kotenev 先生并不知晓 Meilman 此前持有哪些文件。

S.L. Meilman 是 R.S. Dobrishman 夫人与其第一任丈夫所生之子。其继父 J.G. Dobrishman 被上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）视为疑似苏联特工，受雇于 Arnhold & Co.，担任负责苏联产品的“R”部门经理。据报他与苏联贸易代表团及中央消费合作总社（Centrosojus）本地办事处有关联（档案号 I.O. 7860/16）。

(2)

Meilman according to his mother is a student of
Harvard University, U.S.A. and has been resident in that
country for the past three years and that he has applied
for naturalisation as an American citizen. Meilman
resides with his mother and stepfather at Flat 73 Denis
Apartment:, Bubuling Well Road. Dobrishman who has been
residing at this address for about two months, is
negotiating for Flat 65 on behalf of his friend
Dr. Shpilberg, suspected Soviet Agent (File D.3096).

S.L. Meilman is said to be a Soviet courier and that
that he brought with him certain instructions and a
considerable sum of money from Europe for the use of
local Soviet agents.

G. Tchoumshansky
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

(2)

据其母亲称，Meilman 是美国哈佛大学的学生，过去三年一直居住在该国，并已申请归化为美国公民。Meilman 与其母亲和继父同住于静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）Denis 公寓 73 室。Dobrishman 在此地址居住约两个月，正代表其朋友、疑似苏联特工 Shpilberg 医生（档案号 D.3096）洽谈租赁 65 室事宜。

据称 S.L. Meilman 是一名苏联信使，他从欧洲带来了某些指令和一大笔资金，供当地苏联特工使用。

G. Tchoumshansky
D. S.

特别处处长

Translation of extracts from French Police Daily Intelligence Rep.

Report dated August 23, 1932. Activity of Solomon Meilman

We are informed that a certain Solomon Meilman residing
at No 75 Denis Apartments ( No 770-780 Bubbling Well Road ) is be-
lieved to be in very close relations with the Society of Friends of
the USSR in Shanghai( vide our previous reports) as well as with the
Editorial Offices of the pro-communist review" China Forum". We
learn, among other things, that S. Meilman is in very friendly relations
with one R. Erbe, G.P.U. agent, several times mentioned in our reports.
S. Meilman arrived in Shanghai from Europe via U.S.A. travelling, it
is believed, on a Soviet passport. Several days ago S. Meilman obtained
a Russian emigrant's passport through the Council of United Russian
Public Organizations at Shanghai. He is said to have stated that he
was born in Shanghai.
S. Meilman is a young man about 22-25 years of age.

Report dated August 25. Activity of S. Meilman.

We learn that Solomon Meilman who is said to be in very close
relations with the Society of Friends of the USSR in Shanghai(vide
our report dated August 23, 1932 p.1, par.1) had several interviews
with A. Levin ( Centrosojus) recently.

1932年8月23日报告。Solomon Meilman 的活动

据告，居住在 Denis 公寓 75 号（静安寺路 770-780 号）的某位 Solomon Meilman 被认为与上海苏联之友社（参见我方先前报告）以及亲共产主义评论刊物《中国论坛》编辑部关系极为密切。我们获悉，除其他事项外，S. Meilman 与 R. Erbe 关系非常友好，后者是国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）特工，在我方报告中曾多次提及。S. Meilman 经美国从欧洲抵达上海，据信其旅行时持有苏联护照。数日前，S. Meilman 通过上海俄罗斯公共组织联合会获得了俄罗斯侨民护照。据称他曾声明自己出生于上海。
S. Meilman 是一名约 22 至 25 岁的青年。

8月25日报告。S. Meilman 的活动。

我们获悉，据称与上海苏联之友社关系极为密切的 Solomon Meilman（参见我方1932年8月23日报告第1页第1段）最近与 A. Levin（中央消费合作总社）进行了数次会晤。
